{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_id counts: {df["patient_id"].duplicated().sum()}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Number of -999s in biomarker_baseline: {df["biomarker_baseline"].eq(-999).sum()}')

# Check the unique values in arm and severity
print(f'Unique arms: {df["arm"].unique()}')
print(f'Unique severity levels: {df["severity"].unique()}')

# Check if there are any control arm patients with moderate severity
control_moderate = df[(df["arm"] == "control") & (df["severity"] == "moderate")]
print(f'Control arm, moderate severity patient count (before dedup): {len(control_moderate)}')"}
